proposal.reason: Main change is a rebase of device collective kernel implementations and dispatch generation (new generator, function tables, primitives/reduction semantics, and removal of hand-written per-op .cu instantiations). Also needs enqueue review because host-side funcId mapping/dispatch and redop encoding were reworked to match generated kernel IDs. Include kernel-plugin because ext-kernel device redop enum changed (Max/Min folded to MinMax), affecting extension-kernel ABI expectations and plugin compatibility.
